memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: "...I will surely bless you and make your descendants as numerous as the stars in the sky and as the sand on the seashore. Your descendants will take possession of the cities of their enemies, and through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed, because you have obeyed me." - Gen 22:17-18 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
God pours out His promise in overflowing measure: descendants like the stars and the sand, victory over enemies, and - the crowning promise - "through your offspring all nations on earth will be blessed." God's purpose for Abraham was never for Abraham alone. Through him, blessing would flow to the whole world.

This is the golden thread running through all of Genesis. God blesses Abraham not merely to make one man happy, but to bless "all nations on earth" through him. From the beginning, God's heart has been for every people, every tribe, every corner of the world. Abraham was chosen to be a channel of blessing to all.

And notice the word "offspring" - singular in its ultimate fulfilment. Paul makes the stunning point that this promise pointed finally to one particular descendant: "The promises were spoken to Abraham and to his seed... meaning one person, who is Christ" (Gal 3:16). Through Abraham's offspring - through Jesus - the blessing of salvation has now flowed to all the nations of the earth, just as God promised on this mountain.

Think of it: standing on Moriah, Abraham was hearing a promise that reaches all the way to you. If you are in Christ, you are one of the "all nations" blessed through Abraham's offspring. And you are now called into that same purpose - blessed to be a blessing, so that the good news might reach still more of the nations. God's global heart has not changed.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
- Do you see yourself as blessed by God in order to bless others?
- How does God's heart for "all nations" shape how you live?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text:
Lord, thank You that Your promise to Abraham reached all the way to me, through Jesus, the offspring who blesses all nations. Make me a channel of that blessing, that the good news might reach still more people.
Amen.
